title: Levka Gambo of Dinotopia
content: This painting is from my 1992 bookDinotopia, A Land Apart from Time.Will and Sylvia visit Levka Gambo in his Tibetan-inspired hideaway at the top of the Forbidden Mountains.The technique is a thin, transparent wash of oil over illustration board that has been sealed with acrylic matte medium. To dramatize this scene, I set up a light source behind Levka to silhouette him against the background.-----Dinotopia, A Land Apart from Time: 20th Anniversary Edition
